==English== ===Etymology=== {{root|en|ine-pro|*h₃reǵ-}} Borrowed from {{bor|en|la|dīrēctus}}, perfect passive participle of {{m|la|dīrigō||straighten, direct}}, from {{m|la|dis-||asunder, in pieces, apart, in two}} + {{m|la|regō||make straight, rule}}. Compare [[dress]]. {{doublet|en|derecho}}. For the meaning development compare with {{m+|ru|напра́вить||to direct, to turn, to aim, to level, to point}}, {{m|ru|отпра́вить||to send, to dispatch, to forward}} connected with {{m|ru|пра́вить||to govern, to rule, to drive, to steer}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/daɪˈɹɛkt/|/dɪˈɹɛkt/|/dəˈɹɛkt/|[daɪ̯əˈɹɛkt]|a=RP,GA,CA}} ** {{audio|en|En-us-direct.ogg|a=California}} * {{IPA|en|/dɑeˈɹekt/|/dɪˈɹekt/|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|/dəˈɹekt/|a=NZ}} * {{hyphenation|en|di|rect}} * {{rhymes|en|ɛkt|s=2}} ===Adjective=== {{wikidata lexeme|L17936}} {{en-adj}} # Proceeding without [[deviation]] or [[interruption]]. # Straight; not crooked, oblique, or circuitous; leading by the short or shortest way to a point or end. #: {{ux|en|the most '''direct''' route between two buildings}} # Straightforward; sincere. #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Hamlet|II|ii|passage=Be even and '''direct''' with me.}} # Immediate; express; plain; unambiguous. #* {{RQ:Locke Government|1 |passage=He nowhere, that I know, says it in '''direct''' words.}} #* {{RQ:Hallam England|volume=I|chapter=On the English Constitution from Henry VII. to [[w:Mary I of England|Mary]]|page=48|passage=Nor did the government scruple a '''direct''' and avowed interference with elections.}} # In the line of descent; not [[collateral]]. #: {{ux|en|a descendant in the '''direct''' line}} # {{lb|en|astronomy}} In the direction of the general [[planetary]] motion, or from west to east; in the order of the signs; not [[retrograde]]; said of the motion of a celestial body. # {{lb|en|political science}} Pertaining to, or effected immediately by, action of the people through their votes instead of through one or more [[representative]]s or [[delegate]]s. #: {{ux|en|'''direct''' nomination; '''direct''' legislation}} # {{lb|en|aviation|travel}} Having a single [[flight number]]. # {{lb|en|mathematics|logic|of a [[proof]]}} Not employing the [[law of the excluded middle]] or argument by
